n, k = map(int, input().split())
array = list(map(int, input().split()))

parity = [0] * n
for i in range(n):
    if i == 0:
        parity[i] = 1 if array[i] % 2 == 0 else -1
    else:
        parity[i] = parity[i - 1] + 1 if array[i] % 2 == 0 else parity[i - 1] - 1

differences = []
for i in range(n - 1):
    differences.append((abs(array[i + 1] - array[i]), i))
differences.sort(key=lambda d: d[0])

result = 0
for value, index in differences:
    if k >= value and parity[index] == 0:
        k -= value
        result += 1

print(result)
</translated_code>
